summary: Ariana Grande is a singer and actor who moved from Broadway and Nickelodeon to become one of the defining pop stars of the 2010s. Her four-octave range and whistle notes draw comparisons to Mariah Carey.
know: She appeared in the Broadway musical 13 at fifteen and later starred on Nickelodeon's Victorious.
Thank U, Next made her the first solo artist since the Beatles to hold the top three spots on the Hot 100 at once.
Pharrell Williams produced much of Sweetener.

influencedBy.why: Grande has called Carey a major influence, and her whistle notes and runs follow Carey's style.
Houston's big pop-soul singing is one of Grande's stated models.
Martin co-wrote and produced many of her biggest hits.
Pharrell produced much of Sweetener and shaped its sound.
Babyface co-produced tracks on Yours Truly, giving it its 1990s R&B feel.
Her layered background vocals draw on Brandy's style.

cousins.why: Breezy, modern R&B with a light vocal touch.
Sweet, layered R&B harmonies.

summary: Justin Bieber is a Canadian singer discovered on YouTube as a teenager who became one of the world's biggest pop stars. His sound grew from teen pop into electronic-tinged pop and R&B.
know: Manager Scooter Braun found him through YouTube videos and introduced him to Usher.
Baby, co-written with The-Dream, made him a global star in 2010.
Purpose, with production from Skrillex and others, produced three Hot 100 number ones.

influencedBy.why: Usher mentored him and co-signed him to his label partnership.
The-Dream co-wrote and co-produced Baby.
Skrillex produced Sorry and Where Are U Now, moving him toward electronic pop.
Bieber has cited Jackson as a key influence on his singing and performance.
He has named Boyz II Men among the R&B singers he grew up on.

cousins.why: A pop-R&B star who broke through as a teenager.
Smooth modern R&B, as heard on Peaches.

summary: One Direction was a British-Irish boy band put together on The X Factor in 2010. They became one of the biggest pop acts of the 2010s before going on hiatus, with members launching solo careers.
know: Harry Styles, Niall Horan, Liam Payne, Louis Tomlinson and Zayn Malik auditioned as solo acts and were grouped by the show's judges.
Up All Night made them the first UK group to debut at number one in the US with a first album.
Ed Sheeran wrote Little Things and Moments for the group.

influencedBy.why: Sheeran wrote Little Things and Moments for the group.
Their boy band model of harmonies and pop hooks follows the Backstreet Boys.
Their British boy band mania was often compared to the Beatles, and their later pop rock leaned on classic British guitar pop.
NSYNC's teen pop group format is part of their lineage.

influenced.why: Styles came up in One Direction before launching his solo career.

cousins.why: A huge boy group with a devoted global fan base.
Catchy British pop rock that appeals to young fans.
